truthAudit.Summary: Truth audit of Run 2 against true vulnerabilities SC-V3-001 to SC-V3-020. Previous answer reported 7 findings; 5 matched true vulnerabilities (SC-V3-004, SC-V3-005, SC-V3-009, SC-V3-010, SC-V3-013, SC-V3-020), 1 false positive (command injection in execute_admin_command), and missed 14 vulnerabilities. CWE corrections identified for buffer overflow and division by zero findings.

Items.Notes: The previous answer did not report format string injection in runtime log format. Vulnerability exists in string_utils::log_debug_message where user input is passed to printf with a user-controlled format string via runtime_log_format().
The previous answer did not report integer overflow in factorial computation. Vulnerability exists in math_engine::FunctionRegistry::fact where result *= i can overflow for large inputs.

The previous answer did not report use-after-free in memory-pool cleanup. Vulnerability exists in stage_deferred_history_flush and memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup() with potential use of freed memory after sleep_for.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Command injection in ConfigLoader::validate_config via system() call with user-controlled config settings
Items.Notes: Previous answer correctly identified command injection in ConfigLoader::validate_config with matching evidence (system(command.c_str())) and anchors (validator_cmd + " " + config_file). Quote matches title of finding 1.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Buffer overflow in SuperCalc::evaluate_expression due to strcpy when expression length is large
Items.Notes: Previous answer correctly identified stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression with matching evidence (strcpy) and anchors (input_buffer_, dest[src_len], src_len > dest_size). Quote matches title of finding 5.
The previous answer did not report race condition in thread-pool counter. Vulnerability exists in ThreadSafeCounter::increment with volatile long long and lock_guard pattern susceptible to TOCTOU.
The previous answer did not report logic bomb in authentication. Vulnerability exists with login_attempts_ > 5 and EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE trigger.
The previous answer did not report path traversal in configuration loading. Vulnerability exists in ConfigLoader::load_config with config_dir_ + filename allowing directory traversal.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Buffer overflow in ExpressionParser::parse due to unchecked strcpy
Items.Notes: Previous answer correctly identified heap overflow in ExpressionParser::parse with matching evidence (strcpy(expression_buffer_, expr_str.c_str())) and anchors (buffer_size_ = 256, schedule_expression_analysis). Quote matches title of finding 4.
Previous answer correctly identified hardcoded admin secret with matching evidence (ADMIN_SECRET) and anchors. Quote matches title of finding 6.
The previous answer did not report weak PRNG for session tokens. Vulnerability exists with std::mt19937 and uniform_int_distribution(1000, 9999) for predictable tokens.
The previous answer did not report thread-unsafe timestamp cache in logging. Vulnerability exists with static std::tm cached_time and localtime() without proper synchronization.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Command injection in AdminConsole::append_override_audit_event via system() call with environment variable
Items.Notes: Previous answer correctly identified insecure temporary file handling and command injection in append_override_audit_event with matching system(command.c_str()) and anchors (TEMP/TMPDIR, supercalc_emergency.log). Quote matches title of finding 3.
The previous answer did not report persistent authentication state. Vulnerability exists with authenticated_, login_attempts_, and session_token_ retaining state across sessions.
The previous answer did not report unhandled exception in variable parsing. Vulnerability exists with std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command without exception handling.

The previous answer did not report integer underflow in memory-pool block split. Vulnerability exists in memory::MemoryPool::allocate with previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES causing underflow.
The previous answer did not report unbounded recursion in parser. Vulnerability exists in parse_expression/parse_factor with PAREN_OPEN without recursion depth limit enforcement.

The previous answer did not report data race in result cache. Vulnerability exists in ExpressionEvaluator::evaluate_cached with result_cache_ accessed without cache_mutex_ protection in multithreaded context.
The previous answer did not report TOCTOU in config loading. Vulnerability exists in ConfigLoader::load_config with filesystem::exists check followed by sleep_for before ifstream open.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: Division by zero in calculate_route_score when token_length is zero
Items.Notes: Previous answer correctly identified integer division by zero in calculate_route_score with matching evidence and anchors. Quote matches title of finding 7.
